digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Friday, October 16 has eight scheduled work and meeting blocks, six urgent items, and five selected carry-overs. The day turns on confirming the Amazon Connect voicemail recovery and remaining skills-data gap, locking Attorney Review deployment and routing before Monday's go-live, and assigning owners for today's Salesforce security enforcement. Protect the noon work block and decide coverage for the 1:00-1:30 PM EPMO and CLIP overlap; Laura, Jorge, and Nadia are out.

items.label: Lock Attorney Review deployment and routing before Monday's go-live
items.detail: Jhara reports the core issue was fixed yesterday and now needs deployment. The October 15 SOP sets a 15-minute response SLA and defined reassignment path; use today's 12:30 PM check-in to confirm production deployment, ticket routing, escalation coverage, and the final owner before the October 19 launch.

items.label: Set the Salesforce banner path and repair the Grievances display issue
items.detail: Confirm the short-term Do Not Call guidance, Product ownership for the broader banner inventory, and a repair timeline for the Grievances banner that hides the Matter Plan and Documents tabs. Keep this as one coordinated path to avoid duplicating work.

items.label: Close missed owners from yesterday's overlapping meetings
items.detail: Capture any unresolved owners and decisions from the Operations Portfolio, Knowledge Management, Attorney Review, and Maria sessions, then carry the critical changes into today's pipeline and executive-status updates.

items.label: Approve the MHE site request and set the expansion path
items.detail: Halo ticket 0034824 is waiting on Jean's approve-or-deny decision for a central Mental Health Evaluation SharePoint site. Use that decision to support the broader process, security, Legal, Procurement, and ownership path for nationwide vendor expansion.

items.label: Decide the project path for Detention Prevention edge cases
items.detail: Separate operating guidance from changes that require Litify flows, training, SOPs, Legal alignment, and formal intake, then assign the next owner.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect daily standup
items.detail: Confirm that the overnight voicemail changes hold in Salesforce, agree the next deployment and acceptance criteria, and assign the language-skill data cleanup.

items.label: 11:00 AM - Cross-firm Lead Intake Product alignment
items.detail: Clarify Jean's role in the new service line and distinguish it from the continuing-process intake scope.

items.label: Noon focus block overlaps the 12:30 PM Attorney Review check-in
items.detail: Protect the highest-value focus work while ensuring the deployment, routing, SLA, and Monday launch decisions are covered.

items.label: 1:00 PM - EPMO Management overlaps the 1:30 PM CLIP touchpoint
items.detail: Choose coverage and request a written handoff; Jorge is out and Nadia is on PTO, so decision ownership needs to be explicit.

items.label: 2:30 PM - EPMO/IT project pipeline
items.detail: Bring prioritization changes, BA assignments, UAT status, the banner path, and any launch-date changes.

items.label: 3:00 PM - Executive Project Status update
items.detail: Close the week with resolved blockers, revised dates, and named owners reflected in the executive deck.

items.label: Confirm Amazon Connect recovery and close the skills-data gap
items.detail: Test voicemails are now routing as expected with playback visible, but the user-setup list still has 371 blank language responses and only 29 completed answers; skill levels are also required. Confirm the fix holds, assign the roster cleanup, and reset Denver and Wave 1 deployment criteria.

items.label: Assign the Salesforce integration security review
items.detail: Production enforcement begins today. Name an owner to inventory integration users and verify that Litify, Amazon Connect, Revenue Cloud, and other Salesforce integrations use supported authentication, with a response plan for frozen or reauthentication-required accounts.

items.label: Clarify CLIP ownership and lock afternoon coverage
items.detail: Use the 11:00 AM alignment to define Jean's role in the new service line, then decide who covers the 1:30 PM project touchpoint during the EPMO Management overlap and request the decisions in writing.

items.label: Laura Urena remains on PTO through today
items.detail: Plan around reduced project-management coverage where Laura is a key owner.

items.label: Jorge Grijalva is out today
items.detail: Use written handoffs for the pipeline and EPMO discussions that would normally depend on his context.

items.label: Nadia Wilson is on PTO; Astrid Ortega expects a late start
items.detail: Nadia is unavailable, and Astrid said she may arrive up to one hour late after medical testing.

items.label: 8:00 AM - Approve timecards and prepare for the week
items.detail: Use the early block to clear approvals and set the operating plan.

items.label: 10:00 AM - Phase 1 and 2 alignment, then 10:30 AM Amazon Connect
items.detail: The back-to-back meetings make Friday's written decisions and owners especially important.

items.label: Noon - Protected focus block
items.detail: Reserve the hour for unresolved launch or portfolio work before the afternoon reviews.

items.label: 2:00 PM - Business Development Portfolio Review
items.detail: Bring current roadblocks, intake decisions, and any items needing sponsor action.

items.label: 3:00 PM - Attorney Review go-live check-in conflicts with Maria 1:1
items.detail: Choose coverage before Monday; the go-live discussion should capture day-one issues, fixes, decisions, and owners.
